scholarships.title: Becas de apoyo a la investigacion del Instituto Riva-Aguero 2027

existing.description: The Directorate of the Instituto Riva-Aguero, a research institute of the Pontificia Universidad Catolica del Peru, has published its 2027 research support call. Two modalities are offered: an individual research grant of PEN 10,000 and a group research grant of PEN 20,000, each for a maximum of ten months between 2 November 2026 and 3 September 2027. Project topics must fall within the institute's five research lines, covering Peruvian and Latin American history, the state and social processes, literature, art and cultural practices, tangible and intangible heritage, and philosophy, science and education in Peru. Winners must publish their results in a Scopus or Web of Science indexed journal or in an academic-press book, with their affiliation to the Instituto Riva-Aguero stated explicitly, and the individual modality requires the holder to supervise an undergraduate student assistant, which the institute presents as a way of promoting young researchers.
eligibility: Be an ordinary member of the Instituto Riva-Aguero

OR be an associate member with a doctorate who is contracted PUCP teaching staff (TPA, TPC or TC) and has taught at least one course worth a minimum of two credits in the last four regular semesters, including the semesters covered by this call (2025-1, 2025-2, 2026-1 and 2026-2)

OR be an affiliated or honorary member with a doctorate who is part of a research group and, at the time of application, has no pending academic activity, article or research to deliver to the institute
For the group modality, belong to a study or research group registered with and approved by the institute's council up to the closing date of the call
The individual modality requires an undergraduate student assistant on the project, which the institute treats as a requirement and a way of encouraging young researchers
existing.eligibility_summary: Ordinary members of the Instituto Riva-Aguero; associate members who hold a doctorate and are contracted PUCP teaching staff (TPA, TPC or TC) who have taught at least one two-credit course in the last four regular semesters; and affiliated or honorary members who hold a doctorate and form part of a research group and have no pending academic activity, article or research owed to the institute. For the group modality, any study or research group registered and approved by the institute's council is eligible.
benefits: Group research grant of PEN 20,000 for registered and approved research groups
Funding period of up to 10 months, 2 November 2026 to 3 September 2027
Possible complementary funding from PUCP or external sources, in cash or in documentary resources for the research
coverage: Funds may be combined with other PUCP or external financing, which must be declared in the project submission and governed by PUCP rules
requirements: Submit an original research project through the institute's online forms, one for the individual modality and one for the group modality
Include a short updated curriculum vitae for all project participants
Anchor the project in one of the institute's five research lines
Deliver a progress report three months after the start, by 31 January 2027 at the latest
Deliver the article for publication in an indexed journal, and in any case the indexed article, by 31 December 2027
documents: Original research project submitted through the institute's online form
Brief updated curriculum vitae of all participants in the project
For the group modality, the group application form with the required documentation
application_method: Online forms published by the Instituto Riva-Aguero, one for the individual modality and one for the group modality
existing.selection_notes: Selection of winning projects is carried out by a committee made up of the institute's director or research coordinator, a representative of the PUCP Vice-Rectorate of Research and an institute member. The committee may call on additional members of the institute's governing council and national or international experts on the topics involved. Scoring criteria referenced in the bases include relevance, methodological and theoretical consistency, clarity of objectives, feasibility of the timeline, and expected results.
existing.best_fit: Researchers already affiliated with the Instituto Riva-Aguero at the PUCP who work on Peruvian and Latin American history, politics and society, literature and the arts, heritage, or philosophy and education, and who can supervise an undergraduate assistant.
existing.notes:
This is an institute-internal research grant for the institute's own members, not a scholarship open to the general public; eligibility is by membership category, which the call specifies precisely. Failure to deliver the progress report means returning the first payment and being barred from future institute calls.
Funding period: Total amount for the whole grant period of up to 10 months, paid under a contract of award; instalment schedule not published
existing.duration: Maximum 10 months, from 2 November 2026 to 3 September 2027
existing.application_period: Open for submission with a closing date of 16 October 2026; results announced at the end of November 2026; funded period 2 November 2026 to 3 September 2027
existing.program_type: Research institute research grant with a required undergraduate research assistant
